intro: Sangillo Tire Center has been serving the Delaware Valley for more than 60 years, selling and repairing tires for cars and light trucks out of Folsom. Family owned and operated, the shop carries most major tire brands and can usually get a size that isn't on hand within 24 hours. Every purchase includes free tire disposal, and every visit includes a check for damage, proper inflation, tire rotation, and wheel balancing. In many cases the shop can repair a tire instead of selling a replacement.

services.title: Tire Sales
services.blurb: Sangillo's sells most major brands of tires for automobiles and light trucks. If a size isn't in stock, they can normally get it within 24 hours.

services.title: Tire Rotation
services.blurb: Rotating tires on a regular basis saves money through more mileage and fewer replacements. Staff check for damage and proper inflation at every rotation.

services.title: Tire Repair
services.blurb: In many cases Sangillo's is able to repair a tire instead of replacing it. The shop inspects for punctures, cracks, and uneven wear first.

services.title: Wheel Balancing
services.blurb: Every tire purchase includes balancing on state-of-the-art computer balancing machines. Improperly balanced tires cause vibration that increases with speed.

services.title: Free Tire Disposal
services.blurb: Every tire purchase comes with free disposal of the old tire. Sangillo's recycles its scrap tires rather than sending them to landfill.

about: Sangillo Tire Center is a family owned and operated tire shop on MacDade Blvd in Folsom, serving the Delaware Valley for more than 60 years. The shop sells most major tire brands for cars and light trucks and can usually source a size that isn't in stock within 24 hours. Every rotation includes a check for tire damage and proper inflation, and every purchase includes computer wheel balancing plus free disposal of the old tire. In many cases the team can repair a tire instead of selling a new one, and scrap tires are recycled rather than landfilled. The shop is open six days a week: Monday through Friday from 8:00 to 5:00 and Saturday mornings until noon, closed Sundays.

faq.q: What tire brands does Sangillo's carry?
faq.a: Most major brands for cars and light trucks. If a specific size isn't in stock, Sangillo's can normally get it within 24 hours.

faq.q: Do you repair tires or only replace them?
faq.a: In many cases they are able to repair a tire instead of replacing it, after checking for punctures, cracks, or uneven wear.
